# CStar Authority Pointer

This file is a compatibility pointer only. Current repository authority lives in
[`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md), after the operator and global Corvus instructions.
Registry declarations and observed runtime are evidence; neither outranks those
instructions or creates execution authority.

The active boundary is deliberately small:

- CStar kernel MCP owns durable planning, bead/proposal lifecycle, validation,
  completion, and Forge/Researcher request receipts.
- CoS coordinates operator-facing work. PMTs are project-scoped information
  repositories only, and MM has no active routing role.
- Corvus Forge implements through the durable private Hermes/MiniMax request,
  execute, and independent-validation path. Node runtime weaves, dynamic legacy
  commands, and Codex subagents are not substitutes.
- The Node runtime does not create lifecycle beads, invoke host callbacks, or
  infer provider/model authority. Retired or unknown runtime and CLI names fail
  closed before Hall, state, provider, process, source, or Git effects.
- Persona context is style-only and comes only from the bounded field returned
  by `cstar_status`; there is no local configuration-file fallback.
- Scores and production claims require current measured evidence. Installation,
  restart, activation, merge, deployment, live-source, holdout, secrets/config,
  destructive cleanup, and production remain separately operator-gated.

Procedures belong in the runbooks linked from `AGENTS.md`. Historical Trace,
One Mind, Weave, Spell, Gungnir, autonomous-governor, and automatic-Hall prose
has no current authority.
